chapter.verse: Tua lai takin siampi ukpa in, “Hih thu a man hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin Stefen in,
“Ute naute, pate aw, na ngai ta un. Eite i pa Abraham in Haran gamah a om ma-in Mesopotamia gamah a teen’ lai takin minthan’na Pasian kilang a,
‘Nang na gam leh na behte kiang pan na paikhia in la, kong lahna gamah pai in,’ ci-in ama kiangah thu a pia hi.
Tua lai takin Abraham in Khaldea gam pan paikhia a, Haran khua tung a, a teeng hi. A pa a sih khit ciangin Pasian in tu-a a omna uh hih gamah tua khua panin a lalsak hi.
Hih gamah khe sik nading nangawn luahna a piak loh hangin, ‘Nang akipan na tate na tute kiangah hih gam kong pia ding hi,’ ci-in ta khat beek a nei nai lopi-in thu a ciam hi.
Pasian in, “Na suante in gam dangah zin ahi ding uh a, midangte kiangah sila a suak ding uh a, amaute in kum zali a bawlsia ding uh hi.
Amaute sila-a a koihte tungah thu ka khen ding hi. A nung ciangin amaute paikhia-in hih gam sungah kei hong bia ding uh hi,’ ci-in thu a piakhol hi.
Pasian in vunat kiciamna thu a pia hi. Tua mah bangin Abraham in a tapa Isaak nei a, ni giat ni-in vun a at hi. Isaak’ tapa Jakob, Jakob’ tate, mipawl sawm leh nihte’ pate ahi uh hi.
Tua pawlte’ pate in Josef a haza uh a, Izipt gamah a zuak uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in amah tawh omkhawm a, gimna tawlna khempeuh lak pan gumkhia a, Izipt kumpi Faro kiangah maipha leh lungpilna pia a, tua kumpipa in Izipt gam leh ama inn Josef a uk sak hi.
Tua lai takin Izipt gam leh Kanaan gam khempeuh ah kialpi tung a, nakpi-in gimna a tun’ ciangin i pate in annek ding mu zo lo uh hi.
Izipt gamah buhtang a om thu Jakob in a theih ciangin i pate a masa-in a pai sak hi.
A nih veina ciangin Josef in a ute a naute kiangah kilak a, tua ciangin Faro in Josef pawlte a thei hi.
Tua lai takin Josef in a pa Jokob leh ama behte sawmsagih leh nga thu a kamtai sak hi.
Izipt gamah Jakob paisuk a, amah leh i pate zong tua gamah a si khin uh hi.
A sih khit uh ciangin a luang uh Shekhem khua-ah pua uh a, Shekhem khua sungah Hamor’ tate tung pan ngun tawh Abraham in a leisa han sungah a vui uh hi.
“Pasian in Abraham kiangah a thuciam a hun tun’ dektak lai takin Izipt gam sungah tua mite nasia takin a khangto uh a,
Josef a thei lo kumpipa khat in gam a uk hi.
Tua kumpipa in ei mipawlte lungpilna tawh kheem a, naungeekte a hin’ theih loh nadingin a paihmang nadingun i pute i pate a bawlsia hi.
Tua lai takin a meel hoih mahmah Moses suak a, kha thum tawntung a pa inn sungah a kikhoi hi.
Tua nung a kipaihkhiat ciangin Faro’ tanu in tawm a, ama ta bangin a vaak a khoi hi.
Moses in Izipt mite’ pilna khempeuh sin a, kam tawh nasepna tawh a siam hi.
Kum sawmli a phak tak ciangin Israel pawl ama ute naute et ding a lungngai hi.
Izipt mi khat in Israel mi khat a bawlsiat laitak a muh ciangin phula-in, a bawlsiatpa honkhia-in Iziptpa a that hi.
Pasian in ama khut tawh amaute a gumkhia ding hi ci-in a sanggamte in thei dingin Josef in a up hangin a thei kei uh hi.
Zingsang ciangin amau kiangah pai a, “Lawmte aw, u leh nau hi napi-in bang hangin khat leh khat na kibawlsia uh hiam?’ ci-in kilemna thu a gen hi.
A lawmte a bawlsiapa in, ‘Kua in nang ko hong uk ding, thu hong khen dingin hong koih hiam?
Zana Izipt mi na thah bangin kei zong hong that nuam na hi hiam?’ ci-in Moses a nial hi.
Tua kam a zak ciangin Moses tai a, Media gamah zinin a om hi. Tua gamah ta nih a nei hi.
Tua nung kum sawmli a phak khit ciangin Sinai Mual gampalakah, mei a kuang sawl kawm sungah Pasian’ vantungmi khat kilang hi.
Moses in tua lamdang na a muh ciangin a lungmang hi.
A en cian dinga a naih ciangin, ‘Keimah in na pute na pate’ Pasian, Abraham’ Pasian, Isaak’ Pasian, Jakob’ Pasian ka hi hi,’ ci-in Topa’ aw a za hi. Tua lai takin Moses liingin a en ngam kei hi.
Topa in, ‘Na din’na mun a siangtho ahih ciangin na khedap na suah in.
Izipt gamah a om ka mite thuak bawlsiatna ka mu zo a, amau tauna’ aw uh ka za zo hi. Amaute gumkhia dingin kong kumsuk zo hi. Tu-in pai in la, Izipt gamah kong paisak ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
“A kua in nang uk ding leh thu hong khen dingin hong koih ahi hiam?’ ci-a nialna a thuak hih Moses in a uk ding, a gum dingin Pasian in sawlkawm sungah a kilang vantungmi’ sawlna tawh a paisak hi.
Tua pa in Israel mipawlte paikhiatpih a, kum sawmli tawntung Izipt gam San Tuipi sung leh gampa lakah nalamdangte leh limte a bawl hi.
‘Pasian in na ute na naute lakah kei tawh kibang kamsangpa khat note ading kong piangsak ding hi,’ ci-in Israel mipawlte a genna mi in tua Moses ahi hi.
Amah in gampalak mi kikhopna lakah ahi zongin, Sinai mual tungah amah tawh a hopih vantungmi tawh ahi zongin, eite pate tawh ahi zongin, omkhawm a, ei hong piak dingin hin’na thu a ngah hi.
I pate in ama thu mang loin a nial uh a, ‘Komau mai-ah a pai dingin pasiante hong bawlsak in,
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, kote Izipt gam pan hong paikhiatpih hih Moses in bang ci ta hiam, kote in ka thei kei uh hi,’ ci-in Aaron kiangah genin, Izipt gamah a lung a heikik uh hi.

Tua lai takin amaute in bawngno milim khat a bawl uh a, tua milim bia-in, amau khut tawh a bawl uh na tawh a lungdam uh hi. Tua ahih manin Pasian in amaute nungngat-in milim biakna sungah a piakhia hi.
Pasian’ kamsangte’ laibu sungah: ‘Israel mipawlte aw, note in ganhingte gawhna tawh, biakna-in Gampalakah kum sawmli tawntung kei hong bia na hi uh hiam?

Note in Molok biakna inn leh Refan pasian’ aksi bia dingin na bawlsa milim uh na pua ta uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin keimah in note, Babilon khua gal khatah kong paipih ding hi,’ a cih mah bangin, Pasian in a nungngat a, vantung nate biak nadingin tua mite don nawn lo hi.
“Na muhsa lim tawh kibang ciamna puanbuk na bawl in,’ ci-in Moses kiangah a genpa in a vaikhak mah bangin gampa lakah i pate in a nei uh hi.
A piang nunung eite pate in tua buk Gentailte’ lei a luah uh ciangin Joshua tawh a paipih uh hi. Tua Gentailte Pasian in David’ khang dongin i pu i pate mai pan a hawlkhia hi.
Tua David in Pasian’ thupha ngah a, Jakob’ Pasian om nading mun a lam dingin thu a ngen hi.
Ahih hangin Solomon in Pasian ading inn a lam hi.
Sang Pen Pasian in mi khut tawh kibawl inn sungah a teeng zo kei hi. Pasian’ kamsangpa in:
‘Vantung in keima tokhom ahi hi. Leitung in keima khe sikna ahi hi. A bang ci bang biakna innpi kei ading na lam ding hiam? Ka khawlna mun in koi lai takah a om ding hiam?
Ka khut in hih na teng bawl hilo ahi hiam? ci-in Pasian in a gen hi,’ a ci hi.
“Lungkhauh a, lungsim leh bil tawh vunat loh mite aw, note in Kha Siangtho a tawntungin na nial uh hi. Na pute na pate uh a gamtat bangin na gamta uh hi.
No na pute na pate un a bawlsiat loh kamsang kua ahi hiam? ‘Midik Pa hong pai ding ci-a a genkholh mite a that uh hi. Tu-in tua Midik Pa a heekte, a thatte na suak zo uh hi.
Note in vantungmi hong piak bangin Thukham na ngah uh hangin na tang kei uh hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in hih thu a zak uh ciangin a lungso uh a, Stefen tungah a ha a gawi uh hi.
Amah in Kha Siangtho tawh dim a, vantung a ettoh ciangin Pasian’ vangliatna leh Pasian’ ziat lamah a ding Zeisu a muh ciangin,
“En un, van kihong a, Mihing’ Tapa in Pasian’ ziat lamah a ding ka mu hi,” a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in nakpi-in kiko uh a, a bil uh humin ama kiangah lungsim kikhatin a tai uh a,
khua nawlah a hawlkhiat khit uh ciangin suang tawh a deeng uh hi. Teci a pangte in a puan uh Saul kici tangvalpa khat khe kiangah a koih uh hi.
Suang tawh a den’ lai takun Stefen in Pasian kiangah thungenin, “Topa aw, ka kha hong la ta’n,” a cih khit ciangin,
khukdin’a, “Hih khialhna tawh amaute na mawhsak kei in,” ci-in nakpi-in a kiko khit ciangin a si hi.
